description: Test suite for the heartbeat runner and ghost reminder feature in the openclaw project, including various test cases for scheduled reminders, cron events, and heartbeat responses.

methods.name: createHeartbeatDeps
methods.description: Creates mock dependencies for heartbeat, including a mock sendTelegram and getReplySpy.

methods.name: createConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a configuration object and seeds the session store, returning both.

methods.name: expectCronEventPrompt
methods.description: Checks that the called context contains the correct provider and body content for cron events.

methods.name: runCronReminderCase
methods.description: Runs a test case for cron reminder scenarios, enqueuing a system event and verifying behavior.

methods.name: runHeartbeatCase
methods.description: Executes a heartbeat test scenario with provided parameters, returning the result and call details.
